definitions.explanation: Not elaborate or sophisticated; natural and unpretentious in character or appearance.
Showing a lack of worldly experience or artifice; genuine and straightforward.

examples.japanese: {素朴|そぼく}な{味|あじ}わいがある{料理|りょうり}。
examples.english: Cooking with a simple, homely taste.

examples.japanese: {素朴|そぼく}な{疑問|ぎもん}を{持|も}った。
{素朴|そぼく}な{人柄|ひとがら}に{惹|ひ}かれた。
examples.english: I was drawn to their unaffected personality.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverb: {素朴|そぼく}に (simply, naively)
・Noun: {素朴|そぼく}さ (simplicity, naivety)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{素朴|そぼく}な{疑問|ぎもん} (simple/basic question)
・{素朴|そぼく}な{暮|く}らし (simple life)
・{素朴|そぼく}な{美|うつく}しさ (rustic beauty)

NUANCE: Generally positive, implying authenticity and lack of pretense. Can be used for art ({素朴派|そぼくは} = naive art), lifestyle, personality, or ideas.

CONTRAST: Opposite of {洗練|せんれん}された (refined, sophisticated).
